It is designed to replicate the sound and characteristics of the original gray box DOD 250 in a smaller form factor. The pedal features the same controls as the original, including Gain, Tone, and Level. These controls allow you to adjust the amount of overdrive, the tone shaping, and the overall output level of the pedal. The Li’l Gray OD Kit aims to provide the same classic overdrive tones as the original DOD 250, but in a more compact and portable package. Summary created by AI from the original source.
